gates.evidence: the frame-time harness (integration_test/frame_time_test.dart, driver test_driver/perf_driver.dart) is re-runnable but needs an attached device and about three minutes, so it is not run by default. Pass --with-device to run it. The rest of the device matrix - the golden flows, the size sweep, large text, landscape, the migration walk - is still driven by hand.
RELEASE_SIGNING = NOT_RECOVERED: android/key.properties is absent, and no keystore was invented. The build switches over with no code change the moment it appears.
still the stock Flutter logo (dominant colours 0,0,0 / 84,197,248 / 1,87,155); no approved artwork exists, so none was invented
OWNER_VISUAL_GATE is REQUIRED and is never decided by a measurement. P21's technical gates pass; whether the art reads well is human judgement.

P25 reads CLOSED with 0 PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED: every owner decision is made. Four of the six needed no code change - the code already behaved as decided - and two did, D3 (furniture names) and D4 (the long-session memory). Read from the document, not recited. 6 DEFERRED and 4 BLOCKED_EXTERNAL remain in the same file.
BEHAVIOR_AUTHORITY_COUNT=1 (measured): the presented posture is determined by the committed action.

FLOW_GENERATION: no video surface reachable in Flow, and Flow's own banner reports video generation degraded. The video-to-sprite pipeline is built and validated against a local clip; no production video art exists.

note: Gates that can be re-run shell out to the command that already exists; none re-implements a check. The gates that report a standing owner or external state rather than a measurement (RELEASE_SIGNING, LAUNCHER_ICON, OWNER_VISUAL_GATE, PRODUCT_DECISIONS, FLOW_GENERATION) say so in their own evidence instead of pretending to have measured. DEVICE_MATRIX is no longer one of them: its frame-time row is a real measurement now, taken when --with-device is passed and reported as DEFERRED with the reason when it is not. BLOCKED is never reported as PASS.
